general.title: General
general.intro: Grouped app switcher overlay for Alt-Tab style navigation. The Hyprland side is already wired to the bundled Tabber trigger/action scripts.

groupByApp.label: Group windows by app
groupByApp.description: When enabled, multiple windows from the same app appear as one item. Disable it for normal per-window switching.

showHidden.label: Show hidden windows
showHidden.description: When enabled, hidden windows stay visible in Tabber and selecting them restores them from hidden.

containerWidth.label: Container width
containerWidth.description: Minimum switcher width in pixels. Set 0 to keep automatic width.

cardGap.label: Card gap
cardGap.description: Spacing between cards and title slots between 0 and 48.

iconSize.label: Icon size
iconSize.description: Icon size inside each card between 24 and 96.

containerPadding.label: Container padding
containerPadding.description: Inner padding around the header and cards between 8 and 48.

containerPaddingLinked.label: Link container padding sides
containerPaddingLinked.description: When enabled, changing one container padding value updates all four sides.

showHeader.label: Show header
showHeader.description: Show the header row above the switcher cards.

headerAlignment.label: Header alignment
headerAlignment.description: How the header title and count are aligned.

headerPadding.label: Header padding
headerPadding.description: Extra padding around the header row between 0 and 36.

headerPaddingLinked.label: Link header padding sides
headerPaddingLinked.description: When enabled, changing one header padding value updates all four sides.

headerText.label: Header text
headerText.description: Custom text shown in the header when it is enabled.

showWindowCount.label: Show window count
showWindowCount.description: Display the selected group window count in the header badge.

titleVisibility.label: Window title visibility
titleVisibility.description: Choose when window titles are shown below the cards.

titleTruncationMode.label: Title truncation mode
titleTruncationMode.description: How long titles are shortened when there is not enough space.

keybinds.title: Keybinds
keybinds.hyprNoticeTitle: Tabber hotkeys are set in your Hyprland config, not here in the plugin settings.
keybinds.hyprNoticeDescription: Choose any Hyprland keybinds you want and point them at the Tabber global actions, then reload Hyprland.
keybinds.actionsNote: The action bindings below still belong to Tabber itself.
